name: CardShow Dubai
blurb: Trading-card show in Dubai with vendor tables, showcases and a Chunkz meet & greet.

editions.evidence: Official homepage: 'CardShow Dubai October 23-24 2026'; venue confirmed via the event's Eventbrite listing ('Dubai International Card Show'), which gives the venue as Sound Stage 3, Dubai (the official site itself does not state a venue yet)

notes: Homepage shows 'SOLD OUT CHUNKZ TICKETS' with only a generic 100x100 ticket-tier icon, not an actual photo of Chunkz, so he is recorded as a text-only guest for the build step to find a photo for. Eventbrite lists this event as 'Dubai International Card Show' - same show, same dates (Oct 23-24, 2026).
